author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗಮನಿಸರು ನಿನ್ನೆಡೆಗೆ ಅತಿಯಾದ ಸಲುಗೆಯಿರೆ
ದಮನಿಪರು ನಿನತನವ ಕೀಳಾಗಿ ಕಂಡು
ತಮತನವ ಹೇರುದಕೆ ತುಳಿಯುವರು ನಿನ್ನತನ
ಗಮನಿಸಿರೆ ನೀನುಳಿವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: They won’t pay you attention if there is too much familiarity;
seeing you as low, they suppress who you are;
to impose themselves, they will trample your selfhood;
if you notice this, you survive, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Too much familiarity breeds contempt. Some people will push you down to raise themselves. Notice it and keep your boundaries.
